module Main (main) where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  input <- BS.getContents
  let ws = BS.words input
  case ws of
    (mw : nw : _) ->
      let m = readInt mw
          n = readInt nw
          sieve = mkSieve n
          result = [i | i <- [m .. n], sieve !! i]
      in mapM_ (BS.putStrLn . BS.pack . show) result
    _ -> return ()

readInt :: BS.ByteString -> Int
readInt s = fromMaybe 0 $ do
  (v, rest) <- BS.readInt s
  if BS.null rest then Just v else Nothing

mkSieve :: Int -> [Bool]
mkSieve n = go (replicate (n + 1) True) 2
  where
    go s i
      | i * i > n = s
      | s !! i = go (mark i s) (i + 1)
      | otherwise = go s (i + 1)
    mark i s = [ if j == k && k >= i * i && k `mod` i == 0 then False else s !! j
               | j <- [0 .. n], let k = j ]

module Main (main) where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.Array.Unboxed
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  input <- BS.getContents
  let ws = BS.words input
  case ws of
    (mw : nw : _) ->
      let m = readInt mw
          n = readInt nw
          sieve = mkSieve n
          result = [i | i <- [m .. n], sieve ! i]
      in mapM_ (BS.putStrLn . BS.pack . show) result
    _ -> return ()

readInt :: BS.ByteString -> Int
readInt s = fromMaybe 0 $ do
  (v, rest) <- BS.readInt s
  if BS.null rest then Just v else Nothing

mkSieve :: Int -> UArray Int Bool
mkSieve n = accumArray (\_ _ -> False) True (0, n) marks
  where
    marks = concat [ [(j, ()) | j <- [i * i, i * i + i .. n] ]
                   | i <- [2 .. floor (sqrt (fromIntegral n :: Double) :: Double)]
                   , isPrime i ]
    isPrime i = all (\p -> i `mod` p /= 0) [2 .. floor (sqrt (fromIntegral i :: Double) :: Double)]

module Main (main) where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.Array.Unboxed
import Data.Array.ST
import Control.Monad (forM_, when)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  input <- BS.getContents
  let ws = BS.words input
  case ws of
    (mw : nw : _) -> do
      let m = readInt mw
          n = readInt nw
          sieve = mkSieve n
      mapM_ (BS.putStrLn . BS.pack . show) [i | i <- [m .. n], sieve ! i]
    _ -> return ()

readInt :: BS.ByteString -> Int
readInt s = fromMaybe 0 $ do
  (v, rest) <- BS.readInt s
  if BS.null rest then Just v else Nothing

mkSieve :: Int -> UArray Int Bool
mkSieve n = runSTUArray $ do
  arr <- newArray (0, n) True
  writeArray arr 0 False
  if n >= 1 then writeArray arr 1 False else return ()
  let lim = floor (sqrt (fromIntegral n :: Double) :: Double)
  forM_ [2 .. lim] $ \i -> do
    p <- readArray arr i
    when p $ forM_ [i * i, i * i + i .. n] $ \j ->
      writeArray arr j False
  return arr
